hypotheses.R0_rotations_are_dense: The median participation ratio of sampled rotated axes is at least 512 for every rotation.
hypotheses.R1_native_lopo_banks_are_family_specific: At rank 256, native leave-one-pair-out correct-family fidelity exceeds the cyclic wrong-family bank by at least 0.03 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R2_native_lopo_beats_global: At rank 256, native leave-one-pair-out family fidelity exceeds the all-other-pairs global bank by at least 0.03 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R3_native_axis_advantage_survives_lopo: At rank 256, native leave-one-pair-out fidelity exceeds the median of eight rotated leave-one-pair-out bases by at least 0.05 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R4_axis_advantage_survives_decoder_norm_: After ranking coordinates by contribution divided by decoder-column norm, native leave-one-pair-out fidelity exceeds the median rotated result by at least 0.03 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R5_weight_norm_alone_is_insufficient: Native leave-one-pair-out selection exceeds the decoder-norm-only bank by at least 0.05 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R6_same_pair_inclusion_materially_helps: Including the evaluated lexical pair in the discovery bank improves rank-256 native fidelity by at least 0.05 in at least one corpus at each layer.
hypotheses.R7_rotation_null_is_stable: Across eight rotations, the rank-256 leave-one-pair-out downstream-fidelity range is at most 0.10 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R8_layer1_has_more_reusable_native_famil: Native rank-256 leave-one-pair-out fidelity is at least 0.05 higher in Layer 1 than Layer 0 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R9_native_lopo_transfers_ood: TinyStories retains at least 75% of FineWeb native rank-256 leave-one-pair-out fidelity at both layers.
